reason_for_budget: Divisible by 2/3/4 into integer 1000-KRW singles for equal-budget component controls; ROI is stake normalized.
session: cohort/model/league/KST kickoff-day/issue-year-and-round; at most one ticket per strategy and pairwise common session
primary_rank: model_score: genuine saved p where present; vote share is support only, not calibrated p
secondary_rank: estimated_ev for models with genuine numeric probability vector; no EV computed for pure votes
availability: primary uses saved quote/decision times; all legs must be observed at ticket placement and kickoff at least 30 minutes later; latest full event revision first, no older-model fallback; same issue round; no same event or shared team
proxy_dataset: retrospective tipster/year/cohort records without proven quote receipt times reported separately; never pooled with saved-time data
session_pair_rule: earliest checkpoint where both strategies can be constructed; same checkpoint, same cohort/model/league/day/round and budget; no use of outcomes in eligibility or rank
candidate_search: best eligible selection per physical event by fixed rank, then exact combinations of distinct non-shared-team events; highest product rank, deterministic identity tie-break; up to 20 events per checkpoint chosen without outcomes
price: singles saved two-decimal odds; parlay product truncate to 2 decimals then ceiling to 1 decimal; refunded legs become 1.00, all void returns stake
settlement: actual observed leg results, no independent-outcome simulation; product p is a diagnostic independence approximation only
controls: for each parlay, same legs as separate equal-budget singles; track offered odds, hit/any-hit/whole-ticket hit, ROI, total net, daily close drawdown, max losing streak, profitable months, kickoff-day paired uncertainty
league_selection: secondary first 2/3 session dates select among control/high3-5/low2/low3/low4 on common-all checkpoints only, min10 training tickets and min5 evaluation tickets; otherwise insufficient, no winner; all data previously exposed, no promotion
payout_matching: descriptive common final quoted-odds bands, no post-result ticket optimization; absence of overlap is reported
no_claims: All single-buy designations historically verified: false
Independent operator validation of every result: false
